verdict.rationale: Requesty exposes an OpenAI-compatible API across 300+ models. Its docs show cross-provider translation of one tool definition: native web search, where it states it converts 'a single tool definition' to the right provider format. General user-defined function/tool calling with a consistent schema is not documented. missing for 10: explicit docs for user-defined function/tool calling across providers, normalized tool_call response format, streaming tool-call deltas, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: Pass a single tool definition and Requesty translates it to the right provider format automatically.
Requesty is a unified LLM gateway and OpenAI-compatible API for 300+ AI models
